_readme: V.A.T.S. Crit & Luck Calculator (Kat 4 Nov 2026). GAME FILES ONLY - Kat: no in-game testing, no outside sources, no assumptions; anything the files can't answer is a dev question (project doc 'VATS Crit & Luck Calculator - build and dev questions'). The numbers come from src/build_vats_crit_calculator_json.py. The page shows both meter amounts the files hold (Luck curve CT_LuckVATSCriticalCharge, and GMST fVATSCriticalChargeBase + fVATSCriticalChargeMult x Luck) side by side, and does not count Lucky Hit, the weapon's crit charge bonus, Four Leaf Clover misses or whether the crit hit fills the meter, until the devs answer.
